blog_often_publish_new.question: How often do you publish new articles?
blog_often_publish_new.answer: We publish two to four in-depth articles a month and update older guides whenever search or AI behaviour changes materially.

blog_who_writes_avr.question: Who writes the AVR blog?
blog_who_writes_avr.answer: The strategists and developers who deliver client work. Every article is written from live campaign experience, not summarised from other blogs.

blog_content_aigenerated.question: Is the content AI-generated?
blog_content_aigenerated.answer: No. We use AI for research and editing support, but every article is written and fact-checked by a human practitioner.

blog_i_republish_your.question: Can I republish your articles?
blog_i_republish_your.answer: You may quote short excerpts with a link back. Full republication requires written permission.

blog_cover_topics_on.question: Do you cover topics on request?
blog_cover_topics_on.answer: Yes. Send a question through the contact page and if it is broadly useful we will write it up.

blog_which_article_should.question: Which article should I read first?
blog_which_article_should.answer: Start with 'What is AI SEO' for the strategic picture, then the technical SEO checklist for immediate actions on your own site.

blog_offer_newsletter.question: Do you offer a newsletter?
blog_offer_newsletter.answer: We send a short monthly digest of new articles and notable search or AI changes. Ask to be added when you contact us.

blog_tactics_safe_my.question: Are the tactics safe for my site?
blog_tactics_safe_my.answer: Yes. Everything we publish follows search engine guidelines — we do not document manipulative tactics.

blog_cover_markets_outside.question: Do you cover markets outside India?
blog_cover_markets_outside.answer: Yes. Our guides cover US, UK, UAE and European search behaviour alongside Indian markets.

blog_avr_implement_these.question: Can AVR implement what these guides describe?
blog_avr_implement_these.answer: Yes. The guides document the exact processes we run for clients with customized plans. Request an audit to start.
